title: Adherence Ceiling: Tailwise Pharmacy Clinical Review of Renewal Fill Length
content:
*Pharmacist medication-adherence review.*

For a Tailwise Pharmacy renewal order on a prescription whose class requires a DEA-registered prescriber, the days' supply per fill the renewal asks for is no more than the adherence ceiling.

**Coverage.** The adherence ceiling compares the days' supply dispensed on the renewed prescription — the days' supply of its dispensed fills less the days' supply of the fills credited back to it — with the calendar days from its authorization date to the order date, as a percentage.

**Fills dispensed.** The count of the renewed prescription's dispensed fills.

## Ceiling

| Coverage | Fills dispensed | Adherence ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| 90 percent or more | at least 4 | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| at least 75 percent but below 90 percent | at least 4 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 7 days, never more than the class maximum |
| any coverage | fewer than 4 | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |
| below 75 percent | any | the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

Authorized 2026-01-01, renewal order dated 2026-07-20: 200 calendar days. Six fills of 30 days were dispensed, 180 days, and one of them was credited back, leaving 150 days. Coverage is 150 divided by 200, 75 percent, with 6 fills dispensed: the ceiling is the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill plus 7 days, never more than the class maximum. Had nothing been credited back, coverage would be 180 divided by 200, 90 percent, and the ceiling would be the class maximum.

Boundary: coverage of exactly 90 percent reaches the top row; exactly 75 percent reaches the middle row.
